name: Gini — 12-month PD rank ordering
description: Pass if ≥ 0.55, otherwise Fail. Gini = 2 × AUC − 1, using each obligor's 12-month PD at the start of the window and defaults observed over the following 12 months (performing SME and corporate obligors).

name: Default-rate back-test (observed ÷ predicted)
description: Pass if between 0.80 and 1.20, otherwise Fail. Observed 12-month default rate of the cohort performing 12 months before period end ÷ the cohort's exposure-weighted average predicted 12-month PD.

name: Rating grades failing the binomial test
description: Pass if ≤ 1, otherwise Fail. Number of rating grades whose observed default count exceeds the 99% one-sided binomial bound implied by the grade PD.

name: Rating distribution stability (PSI)
description: Pass if ≤ 0.10, otherwise Fail. PSI = Σ (actual% − expected%) × ln(actual% ÷ expected%) over rating grades, current portfolio against the development sample.

name: Exposure on fallback PD (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 2.0%, otherwise Fail. Exposure of obligors without a valid current rating, given the fallback PD ÷ total exposure in scope.

name: LGD back-test (realised ÷ predicted)
description: Pass if between 0.85 and 1.15, otherwise Fail. Realised LGD on workouts closed in the last 12 months ÷ LGD predicted at the date of default.

name: Collateral valuations older than 12 months (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 10.0%, otherwise Fail. Collateral value with a valuation date more than 12 months before period end ÷ total collateral value used in LGD.

name: CCF back-test (realised ÷ predicted EAD)
description: Pass if between 0.90 and 1.10, otherwise Fail. Realised exposure at default ÷ EAD predicted 12 months before default, facilities that defaulted in the last 12 months.

name: Defaults drawn above the approved limit (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 5.0%, otherwise Fail. Defaulted facilities whose drawn balance at default exceeded the approved limit ÷ defaulted facilities in the last 12 months.

name: Defaults not in Stage 2 twelve months before (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 30.0%, otherwise Fail. Obligors that defaulted in the last 12 months and were in Stage 1 twelve months before default ÷ all defaults in the last 12 months.

name: Stage 2 share of performing exposure (%)
description: Pass if between 6.0% and 14.0%, otherwise Fail. Stage 2 exposure ÷ (Stage 1 + Stage 2) exposure at period end.

name: Stage 2 triggered only by the 30-day backstop (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 20.0%, otherwise Fail. Stage 2 exposure where the only SICR trigger met is 30+ days past due ÷ total Stage 2 exposure.

name: Manual staging overrides (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 8.0%, otherwise Fail. Exposure whose stage was changed manually from the rule-based stage ÷ total exposure in scope.

name: Base-case GDP forecast error (pp)
description: Pass if ≤ 1.5 pp, otherwise Fail. |Base-scenario forecast of Qatar real non-hydrocarbon GDP growth − published outturn (PSA)|, percentage points, for the quarter four quarters back.

name: Days since scenarios were last refreshed
description: Pass if ≤ 100 days, otherwise Fail. Calendar days between period end and the approval date of the scenario set used in that period's ECL.

name: Weighted-to-base ECL uplift (%)
description: Pass if between 2.0% and 15.0%, otherwise Fail. (Probability-weighted ECL − base-scenario ECL) ÷ base-scenario ECL.

name: Unexplained ECL movement (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 5.0%, otherwise Fail. ECL movement not attributed to a driver (new business, repayments, stage transfers, risk parameters, macro, overlays) ÷ opening ECL.

name: Exposure reconciliation break to the ledger (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 0.5%, otherwise Fail. |Exposure in the ECL engine − general-ledger exposure| ÷ general-ledger exposure, in-scope portfolios at period end.

name: Post-model adjustments (% of ECL)
description: Pass if ≤ 10.0%, otherwise Fail. Management overlays and post-model adjustments ÷ total reported ECL.

name: Gini — rating rank ordering
description: Pass if ≥ 0.50, otherwise Fail. Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the model grade against defaults over the following 12 months.

name: Rating overrides (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 15.0%, otherwise Fail. Obligors whose approved grade differs from the model grade by one notch or more ÷ obligors rated in the period.

name: Ratings older than 12 months (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 5.0%, otherwise Fail. Obligors in scope whose last approved rating is more than 12 months old at period end ÷ obligors in scope.

name: Gini — rating rank ordering
description: Pass if ≥ 0.50, otherwise Fail. Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the model grade against defaults over the following 12 months.

name: Rating distribution stability (PSI)
description: Pass if ≤ 0.10, otherwise Fail. PSI over rating grades, current portfolio against the development sample.

name: Rating overrides (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 15.0%, otherwise Fail. Obligors whose approved grade differs from the model grade by one notch or more ÷ obligors rated in the period.

name: Realised vs priced margin variance (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 8.0%, otherwise Fail. |Realised net interest margin − margin priced by the model| ÷ priced margin, loans disbursed in the last 12 months.

name: Deals priced below the model floor (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 10.0%, otherwise Fail. Loans disbursed in the period at a rate below the model's floor rate (approved exceptions) ÷ loans disbursed.

name: Gini — transaction score
description: Pass if ≥ 0.40, otherwise Fail. Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the score at application against 12-month default.

name: Largest input-feature PSI
description: Pass if ≤ 0.10, otherwise Fail. Highest PSI across the model's input features, applications in the period against the development sample.

name: Approval-rate gap between customer segments (pp)
description: Pass if ≤ 5.0 pp, otherwise Fail. Largest difference in model-recommended approval rate between customer segments (sector, company age band, size band), percentage points.

name: Applications with insufficient statement history (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 10.0%, otherwise Fail. Applications with fewer than 6 months of bank-statement data ÷ applications scored.

name: Gini — bureau score (individuals)
description: Pass if ≥ 0.45, otherwise Fail. Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the score against 12-month default.

name: Bureau hit rate (%)
description: Pass if ≥ 90.0%, otherwise Fail. Applicants matched to a credit bureau record ÷ applicants scored.

name: Gini — bureau score (corporates)
description: Pass if ≥ 0.45, otherwise Fail. Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the score against 12-month default.

name: Bureau hit rate (%)
description: Pass if ≥ 85.0%, otherwise Fail. Companies matched to a credit bureau record ÷ companies scored.

name: Actual ÷ modelled stressed outflow (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 80.0%, otherwise Fail. Largest actual 30-day net cash outflow in the period ÷ modelled 30-day stressed net outflow.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: LCR forecast error (pp)
description: Pass if ≤ 5.0 pp, otherwise Fail. |Forecast LCR − actual LCR| at period end, forecast made one quarter earlier.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: NII forecast error (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 6.0%, otherwise Fail. |Forecast NII − actual NII| ÷ actual NII for the quarter, forecast made one quarter earlier.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: Deposit run-off back-test (actual ÷ assumed)
description: Pass if between 0.80 and 1.20, otherwise Fail. Actual run-off of non-maturity deposits in the last 12 months ÷ run-off assumed by the model.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: Losses exceeding scenario severity (count)
description: Pass if ≤ 0, otherwise Fail. Internal and relevant external loss events in the last 12 months larger than the severe loss of the matching scenario.

name: Scenarios reviewed in the last 12 months (%)
description: Pass if ≥ 90.0%, otherwise Fail. Scenarios with a business review dated in the last 12 months ÷ scenarios in the register.

name: High-risk customer share (%)
description: Pass if between 5.0% and 12.0%, otherwise Fail. Customers rated High risk ÷ active customers at period end.

name: Suspicious activity reports on low-risk customers (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 20.0%, otherwise Fail. Suspicious activity reports filed in the last 12 months on customers rated Low risk at the time ÷ all reports filed.

name: Customer risk reviews overdue (%)
description: Pass if ≤ 5.0%, otherwise Fail. Customers whose periodic risk review is past due ÷ active customers.
